items.source: This callback will also be invoked after a short-circuiting triggered by a InstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor.postProcessBeforeInstantiation(Class, String) method, in contrast to all other BeanPostProcessor callbacks.
items.translation: 此回调也会在由`InstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor.postProcessBeforeInstantiation(Class, String)`方法触发的短路之后被调用，这与所有其他`BeanPostProcessor`回调不同。

items.source: The default implementation returns the given bean as-is.
items.translation: 默认实现原样返回给定的bean。

items.source:
The only requirement for it to work is that it needs to be defined
in application context along with "non-native" Spring AdvisorAdapters
that need to be "recognized" by Spring's AOP framework.
items.translation: 它生效的唯一要求是，必须将其与需要被 Spring AOP 框架“识别”的“非原生”Spring AdvisorAdapters 一起定义在 application context 中。

items.source:
Specify the AdvisorAdapterRegistry to register AdvisorAdapter beans with.
Default is the global AdvisorAdapterRegistry.
items.translation: 指定用于注册 AdvisorAdapter 豆的 AdvisorAdapterRegistry。默认值为全局 AdvisorAdapterRegistry。

items.translation: BeansException - 在发生错误时

items.source: the bean instance to use, either the original or a wrapped one; if null, no subsequent BeanPostProcessors will be invoked
items.translation: 要使用的 Bean 实例，即原始实例或包装后的实例；如果为null，则不会调用后续的 BeanPostProcessor。

items.source: In case of a FactoryBean, this callback will be invoked for both the FactoryBean instance and the objects created by the FactoryBean. The post-processor can decide whether to apply to either the FactoryBean or created objects or both through corresponding bean instanceof FactoryBean checks.
items.translation: 对于 FactoryBean，此回调将针对 FactoryBean 实例以及由 FactoryBean 创建的对象均被调用。后处理器可以通过相应的 `bean instanceof FactoryBean` 检查来决定是应用于 FactoryBean、创建的对象还是两者。
